searches.label: Ford Transit 350
searches.requirements: MUST be a passenger van (12 or 15 passenger) with MEDIUM or HIGH roof. Low roof is unusable for the business. Cargo/crew/cutaway/box configurations do not fit. Verify roof height and seating from PHOTOS, not the listing title (FB titles are unreliable).
searches.notes: For transportation business. Watch for fleet abuse, deferred maintenance, non-functioning equipment, rebuilt/salvage titles.

searches.label: Toyota Land Cruiser (80 Series)
searches.notes: 80-series only (1990-1997, FJ80/FZJ80). Value factors: factory triple lockers, rust-free frame/body, stock vs modified, maintenance history (head gasket on 1FZ-FE, birfields, knuckle service).
